title: No safe crossing at Plac Centralny
description: Crossing from the south side of Plac Centralny to the tram stop means dodging cars coming off the roundabout. There is no proper zebra where everyone actually walks, and elderly residents are scared to cross.

title: Pedestrians stranded at Plac Centralny tram stop
description: Getting off the tram at Plac Centralny you have to wait ages on a tiny island while cars circle the square. The light for pedestrians is far too short.

title: Dark path through Park Lotników
description: The main walking path in Park Lotników Polskich is completely dark after 18:00 in autumn. Several lamps between the pond and al. Jana Pawła II have not worked for weeks.

title: Broken lamps near park playground
description: Two street lamps next to the playground in Park Lotników Polskich are out. Parents walking home with kids in the evening can barely see the path.

title: Litter piling up at Zalew Nowohucki
description: After every warm weekend the shore of Zalew Nowohucki is covered with bottles, packaging and leftover grill trays. Nobody seems to clean it until Wednesday.

title: Broken paving slabs on al. Róż
description: Many slabs on al. Róż are loose or lifted by tree roots, especially near the fountain. I have already seen two people trip there this month.

title: Groups drinking in os. Złotego Wieku courtyard
description: Every evening a group gathers on the benches in the courtyard of os. Złotego Wieku, drinking and shouting at passers-by. Residents are afraid to walk through after dark.

title: Abandoned car near Kolbe church
description: A grey Opel with flat tyres and no plates has been parked near the church of św. Maksymiliana Kolbego on os. Tysiąclecia for months. It takes a space and collects rubbish.

title: Loud bar until 3am on os. Kalinowe
description: The pub in the pavilion on os. Kalinowe plays music with open doors until 3am on weekends. People smoking outside are shouting under our windows.

title: Cyclists cut off at Rondo Czyżyńskie
description: The bike crossing at Rondo Czyżyńskie is badly marked and drivers turning right never look. I almost got hit twice this month.

title: Gridlock after events at Tauron Arena
description: After every concert at Tauron Arena on ul. Lema the whole area is blocked for an hour. There is no traffic management and taxis stop wherever they like.

title: Humming from EC Łęg at night
description: A constant low humming comes from the heat and power plant on ul. Ciepłownicza, much louder at night. It started after the recent maintenance.
